items.headline: Connelly: What changed in college football during September
items.description: It's dangerous to lean on lessons learned in one month, but here's what we think we know so far.

items.headline: Top-25 SEC matchup features Alabama visiting Mississippi State
items.description: No. 7 Alabama (4-0) at No. 16 Mississippi State (4-0), Oct. 3 at 12 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Florida jumps to No. 8; Texas, Georgia, Notre Dame top 3 again
items.description: Florida made a massive jump in the Associated Press Top 25 and landed in the top 10 for the first time in five years while four teams joined the rankings in a major shuffle.

items.headline: What we know through CFB's Week 4, plus Kamario Taylor's rise and Michigan's karma
items.description: The best seasons are the ones that force us to keep questioning our assumptions.

items.headline: Kamario Taylor leads 4th-quarter rally and No. 24 Mississippi State beats No. 19 Missouri 31-24
items.description: — Kamario Taylor threw for 360 yards and three touchdowns, including a tiebreaking, 24-yard pass to Sanfrisco Magee with 3:57 remaining, and No. 24 Mississippi State rallied past No. 19 Missouri 31-24 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Texas' UT jab at Tennessee leads top trolls of college football Week 4
items.description: Texas left Knoxville with a parting shot at its hosts centered on the two schools' shared UT acronym.
